hook: Placeholder: two countries can have the same number of people and very different futures. A population pyramid shows why.

prereq.q: Placeholder: what does physiological density compare?
prereq.why: Placeholder: people per unit of farmland.

prereq.q: Placeholder: what is the scale of analysis of a map of provinces?
prereq.why: Placeholder: the data are for parts of one country.

chain.cause: Many children are born for years
chain.effect: the pyramid has a wide base

chain.cause: People live longer and fewer are born
chain.effect: the top widens and the base narrows
fewer people reach working age later

ideas: Placeholder: a population pyramid shows age structure and sex ratio.
Placeholder: its shape hints at future needs: schools or care for older people.

misconception.wrong: Placeholder: a wide pyramid means a large population.
misconception.right: Placeholder: a wide base means a young population, whatever its size.

summary: Placeholder: a population pyramid shows the age structure and sex ratio of a population, and its shape hints at growth, decline and future needs.
